candidates.label: ひより・KITE寄りの立ち絵
candidates.prompt:
Create one beautifully finished ORIGINAL art-direction candidate for this existing Japanese shisha narrative game. Use the supplied GAME CHARACTER PNGs as the highest-priority identity references: retain the exact character's hair style/color, eye color, recognizable face, adult age impression, clothing and accessories. These are alternate rendering studies, not replacements with a movie's characters. The supplied KITE/BASTARD stills are VISUAL TECHNIQUE references only, never borrow their characters, clothes, jewelry, settings or plot. Emulate the actual hand-inked, hand-painted CEL ANIMATION qualities visible in these early/late-1990s OVA frames: expressive drawn eyes, simple small mouths and noses, confident organically varied ink contours, deliberate angular solid shadow shapes with two or three paint tones, large designed ribbon-like hair highlights, opaque painted color. Skin and clothing are flat cel paint, not softly airbrushed digital anime. Backgrounds, where requested, are exceptionally composed traditional gouache anime production art, with painted architecture, depth and motivated light. The result should read as an excellent traditional OVA frame, not current AI anime with a retro noise filter. Beautiful clean readable drawing; no VHS effects, fake aging, artificial pixelation, 3D rendering, photographic bokeh, glossy doll faces or giant ornate UI. Every person is the named adult game character. No words, logo, watermark, UI or caption in the artwork. Use warm and cool colors according to the actual scene, not the same sunset lounge in every image.

Direction K: closely study the actual KITE 1998 reference frames. Bold eye contours and expressive lashes, dimensional faces built from CLEAR flat cel-color planes, restrained smaller mouths, strong asymmetrical light/shadow shapes, burgundy-brown hair highlight bands, steel-blue/teal urban ambience contrasted with small warm light accents. Intimate cinematic framing and substantial dark shapes. Keep the original game character attractive, expressive and recognizable; do not copy Sawa or her clothing.

Portrait full-body transparent cutout, ONE woman: Hiyori, 25. Keep her pink-brown HIGH ponytail, soft bangs, light brown eyes, small ivory stand collar and French sleeves on a delicately lace-front blouse, black belted slacks, black loafers, small black handbag and wristwatch from the game PNG. Slightly lowered eyes, shy small bittersweet smile, one hand touching hair beside her ear. A healthy adult office worker acting wistful, not ill or weak. This is a deliberately MUCH STRONGER authentic 1990s OVA rendering experiment, editing the supplied existing GAME scene. The user found the previous concepts too modern: thin elegant contemporary anime contours, numerous subtle clothing/hair shades and glossy CG-like background materials. Correct those exact problems. The supplied ACTUAL OLD OVA frame(s) are the AUTHORITATIVE visual-rendering reference, even where that means redrawing rather than lightly filtering the game image. The GAME scene is only the reference for character identity, clothes and scene content, NOT for rendering.
Reconstruct the ENTIRE image as a production cel over a traditional hand-painted 1990s anime background. The characters are clean hand-inked animation drawings with emphatic outer contours and economical intentional interior lines. Eyes are period-designed expressive LARGE irises and broad white eye shapes with ONE or TWO simple painted highlights; no modern tiny jewel-eye detailing. Noses and lips are small economical ink/paint marks, not realistically modeled noses or glossy rendered lips. Hair is made of clear LARGE designed locks, with broad ONE-PAINT flat ribbon/jagged highlights, not dozens of fine shiny strands. Skin uses a FLAT peach/brown base and ONE strong simple shadow tone, optionally a tiny accent; clothing uses flat LOCAL paint and ONE large designed shadow plane, no gradient layers, no microtexture, no fussy repeated folds. Hands must also be drawn with clean economical ink and the same simple cel paint. Keep the adult character's actual age and body proportions; warm expressive adult faces, not children or chibi.
BACKGROUND must be newly interpreted as authentic opaque GOUACHE production art, restrained period color design with hand-painted architecture, separate foreground/midground/distance planes, dry pigment and soft painted edges. NO polished 3D surface highlights, no CG reflections, no photograph or camera depth-of-field, no photographic bokeh or decorative digital bloom. Never just reduce contrast or add noise to the previous image. No VHS, scanlines, scratches, blurry low resolution, fake film-aging overlays, or paper stains from the cel photos. A high-quality sharp master of an actual hand-painted 1990s OVA frame. NO UI, labels, words, border or watermark. Landscape 4:3 cinematic still. The game characters and clothes remain identifiable; never borrow the anime reference's hair, clothing, jewelry, weapons, identity or plot.

Redraw the SAME GAME still of Hiyori, adult 25, at the rainy tonari window, retaining the same high pink-brown ponytail, brown eyes, ivory lace stand-collar French-sleeve blouse, black slacks, wristwatch, mug and handbag. Use the ACTUAL 1992 BASTARD!! cel's drawing construction VERY strongly: wide clear white eye shapes, LARGE ROUND brown irises with single white painted highlights, a small short nose mark, tiny gentle mouth and a SHORT soft chin. Friendly adult rather than toddler proportions. Character skin is clean flat peach paint plus ONE large cocoa-colored cel shadow. Ponytail becomes a few generous designed hair locks with ONE bold salmon/copper painted highlight band and burgundy shadow. Blouse is flat ivory paint with ONE lavender-gray shadow plane and selective lace linework. Hand-inked outer contour stronger than internal detail. Background is quiet low-chroma slate/ochre/olive traditional anime gouache, without glassy CG gloss; a little amber mosaic-lamp light. She gives the player a small shy smile while holding her mug. Use the anime's actual old clean cel drawing, not an old-looking modern digital anime illustration; do not copy Yoko's red hair, costume or identity.

qa_notes: 20候補を表示して本人性・衣装・場所・構図を目視確認。正式採用前の比較用。
01の立ち絵には周囲に半透明の光がある。立ち絵として採用する場合はアルファの整理が必要。
08および13の背景には原景由来の展示用シーシャ器具が残る。機材採用には実物写真との追加QAが必要。
一部の案には現代的な細部・塗りが残る。好みの番号を選んだ後、セル影と線の簡略化を揃える。
喫煙・HMD装着・炭配置の場面は今回の比較対象外。ゲーム挙動・正式素材・台詞は変更していない。

anime_references.title: 顔・目の輪郭と非対称のセル影
anime_references.note: 太めの目の輪郭、上下のまつ毛、少数の色面で作る顔の立体感。髪の反射は細い光沢を重ねず、形を設計した帯として見る。

anime_references.title: 窓光と、大きな暗い面の構図
anime_references.note: 小さい窓からの光、壁に落ちる影、手前と奥の暗さの差。人物と背景が同じ照明で描かれている点を参照。

anime_references.title: 二人の距離と静かな画面
anime_references.note: 会話の二人を並べたときの大きさと距離、落ち着いた色数。キャラの姿や服装ではなく、画面の組み方を参照。

anime_references.title: 目・頬・小さな口とセル影
anime_references.note: 大きく明快な瞳、柔らかい頬、小さな鼻と口。強い影を置いても顔の可愛さが残る面の分け方。出品されている制作セルの写真。

anime_references.title: 夜の人物と髪の帯状ハイライト
anime_references.note: 寒色の夜景と、顔・髪の暖かい色の組み合わせ。髪を束として描く輪郭、明快な反射の帯、二人の構図。制作セル写真。

anime_references.title: 人物と背景の描き込みの役割
anime_references.note: 人物は明快な線とセル塗り、背景は美術として描く。同じ光と色の中で、それぞれの描き込み量を使い分ける。

owner_feedback: 初稿は古さがあるが当時の90年代感が弱い。より強めてよい。
stronger_revision: 21〜24は実際のOVAの線・顔・色面・髪のハイライトを優先して描き直した。画質低下やノイズ加工を解決策にしていない。
